name: Gnoarn
summary: In Ironforge, Gnoarn helps his scattered people find aid. After Gnomeregan fell, the exiled gnome made his home in Tinker Town and began directing travelers to fellow engineers and survivors.

sections.title: A Displaced Citizen of Gnomeregan
sections.body: Troggs invaded Gnomeregan, and catastrophic radiation drove its people from the great underground city. The Bronzebeard dwarves gave Gnoarn refuge in Tinker Town. From there, he sends travelers to gnomes in need across Alliance lands, including the stranded pilot Bingles Blastenheimer in Loch Modan and the ambitious engineer Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind.

faq.answer: Gnoarn is a gnomish survivor living among the refugees in Tinker Town, Ironforge's gnomish quarter. He directs travelers to help exiled gnomes across Alliance lands.
Gnoarn lives in Tinker Town, in northeastern Ironforge, among the machinery and workbenches of his exiled kin.

faq.q: What tasks does Gnoarn give out?
faq.answer: Gnoarn directs travelers to help scattered gnomes. He sends them to Loch Modan to check on the missing pilot Bingles Blastenheimer, or to Stormwind to speak with the inventor Shoni the Shilent about her gyrodrillmatic excavationators.
Before Gnomeregan fell, Gnoarn was known for his eccentric 'gnomefro' hairstyle. Catastrophic fallout and radioactive venting devastated the city and took his hair with it.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see Gnoarn's resolve in how he keeps displaced engineers in touch across the Eastern Kingdoms.
As an Alliance hero passing through Ironforge, you can speak with Gnoarn for leads on gnomish engineering efforts in Dun Morogh, Loch Modan, and Stormwind.
